Vote Centers

Vote at Any Convenient Vote Center

Marion County Voters Have Options for In-Person Voting

Whether you’re looking for an in-person voting location close to work, home, or anywhere else, you’ve got options. All registered Marion County voters can vote at any Vote Center on Election Day, thanks to our electronic Poll Pad technology. This also means that all registered voters can vote at any of the Early Voting locations ahead of Election Day.

To find the closest Vote Center, you can use the map or table on this page. Type in an address—including the ZIP code—to find the nearest polling location and see if it is open for Early Voting. You can also find a list of Indy Landmark locations. Vote in an iconic place in the city you’ve always wanted to visit.

For more detailed information about Marion County Vote Centers, you can download the full list of Vote Centers with more information about precincts and more. The full Vote Center Plan will be available for download ahead of each election upon its approval by the Marion County Election Board.

About IndyVOTES

Vote at Any IndyVOTES Location

Due to significant investments in election equipment, voters can choose to vote at any Vote Center in Marion County for a faster, easier, and secure voting experience.

FASTER

The traditional printed poll book has been replaced by a simple-to-use electronic Poll Pad. Poll workers now simply scan a voter’s valid photo ID and instantly access county voter registration records, resulting in a faster voter check-in.

EASIER

Voters mark their ballots securely on the ExpressVote touchscreen machines —generating the ballot specific to the voter, no matter which polling place they choose. The ExpressVote provides a printed ballot, which allows voters to verify their selections before casting the ballot in the DS200 tabulation machine and provides a paper trail for every vote.

ANYWHERE

Thanks to these advances, voters in Marion County are able to vote conveniently and securely at ANY Vote Center.
